title: Canonical completed compact-support calculus data
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring with adic coefficient datum $d$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Use completed-module pullback and direct image [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] and exact open extension [def-cbc-completed-open-scalar-quotient-interface]. For a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow j\overline X\xrightarrow pY)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], define $J_j=j_!$ and $F_c=Rp_*J_j$. For an open Cartesian square $(a,j',j,g)$ [def-cbc-open-immersion-square], define $\beta^{-1}:J_{j'}La^*\to Lg^*J_j$ as the $J_{j'}\dashv Lj'^*$ transpose of the pulled-back open unit, using the canonical pullback compositor; define $\beta$ as its inverse. For base-changed compactifications and a chosen proper square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], define $\operatorname{Ex}_c$ to be exactly the ordered completed exchange of [def-cbc-completed-exchange-map] on its complete domain. The quasi-compactness structure on the base-changed morphism is the one deduced from the open Cartesian square. For a compatible tower $c_f,c_h,c_{hf}$ with $b:\overline X_f\to\overline X_{hf}$ and proper $p:\overline X_{hf}\to\overline Y_h$, satisfying $j_fb=j_{hf}$, $bp=p_fj_h$, $pp_h=p_{hf}$ and the Cartesian square $(b,p_f,p,j_h)$, define $F_{c_h}F_{c_f}\to F_{c_{hf}}$ by pushing forward the canonical proper/open mate, followed by the open and proper compositors. Its proper/open map is the proper-adjunction mate of the open comparison obtained from the Cartesian pullback and projection onto the clopen image of $(b,p_f)$. These are cbcSupport, cbcJ, cbcBetaInv, cbcBeta, cbcExchange, cbcBaseChangeQuasiCompact and cbcTowerCompositionMap. This definition makes no claim of completed exchange invertibility or identity/pasting.
